stratagems.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
stratagems.description: When an enemy Falls Back from a DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit, inflict possible mortal wounds and then make a Normal move that closes on that enemy.

stratagems.name: INSANITY’S IRE
stratagems.description: After an enemy shoots a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit, that unit can make a D6-inch surge move.

stratagems.name: MASKS OF DEATH
stratagems.description: Protect a targeted DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit: attacks against it suffer -1 to Hit for the phase.

stratagems.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
stratagems.description: After a DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit destroys an enemy or pushes it Below Half-strength, activate that unit’s Reanimation Protocols.

stratagems.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
stratagems.description: A DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit can make Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6 inches for the phase.

stratagems.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
stratagems.description: Boost a DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit against damaged enemies: +1 to Hit below Starting Strength and +1 to Wound as well when the target is Below Half-strength.

enhancements.name: Eldritch Nightmare
enhancements.description: DESTROYER CULT model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Eternal Madness
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. In the Fight phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit is destroyed, if that model had not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Ingrained Superiority
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Soulless Reaper
enhancements.description: DESTROYER CULT model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit is selected to Fall Back, roll one D6. On a 3+, that unit cannot Fall Back and must Remain Stationary.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
stratagems.description: A shooting NECRONS unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 against targets within half range; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, it can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
stratagems.description: Return a just-destroyed NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER at the end of the phase with half its starting wounds; each model can use this once per battle.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
stratagems.description: Give a NECRONS unit +1 Strength on melee weapons for the phase; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, also improve melee AP by 1.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
stratagems.description: Give a NECRONS unit ASSAULT on ranged weapons for the turn; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, also re-roll its Advance roll.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
stratagems.description: After an enemy attack destroys models in a NECRONS unit, activate Reanimation Protocols for D3 wounds, or D3+1 if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading it.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
stratagems.description: After an enemy destroys a NECRONS unit in Shooting, a nearby NECRONS CHARACTER unit can shoot back at that attacker.

enhancements.name: Enaegic Dermal Bond
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: Nether-realm Casket
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Veil of Darkness
enhancements.description:
NECRONS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do: 
- Place this unit in strategic reserves. 
- This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase. 
- This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

stratagems.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
stratagems.description: A targeted CANOPTEK unit can only be selected by ranged attacks from models within 18 inches for the rest of the phase.

stratagems.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
stratagems.description: After a CRYPTEK model is destroyed, friendly CANOPTEK models gain +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound against the unit that killed it for the rest of the battle.

stratagems.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
stratagems.description: A CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit wholly inside the Power Matrix gains DEVASTATING WOUNDS for the phase.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
stratagems.description: After a nearby enemy finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, a CANOPTEK unit within 8 inches can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

stratagems.name: SOLAR PULSE
stratagems.description: At the start of Shooting, a CRYPTEK designates a nearby objective; friendly NECRONS attacks against units near that objective gain IGNORES COVER for the phase.

stratagems.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
stratagems.description: When a CANOPTEK unit wholly within the Power Matrix is declared as a charge target, activate its Reanimation Protocols.

enhancements.name: Autodivinator
enhancements.description: CRYPTEK model only. Each time your opponent gains a CP as a result of an ability, roll one D6: on a 2+, you also gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Sanctum
enhancements.description: CRYPTEK model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Hyperphasic Fulcrum
enhancements.description: CRYPTEK model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, if that unit is wholly within your army's Power Matrix, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Metalodermal Tesla Weave
enhancements.description: CRYPTEK model only. Once per phase, when an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target of a charge, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: ANIMUS CURSE
stratagems.description: After a CRYPTEK model is destroyed, friendly NECRONS models can re-roll Hit rolls against the attacking unit for the rest of the battle.

stratagems.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
stratagems.description: Protect a CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit being attacked: NECRON WARRIORS gain a 5+ invulnerable save, while IMMORTALS gain a 4+ invulnerable save for the phase.

stratagems.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
stratagems.description: A NECRONS unit can ignore modifiers to Ballistic/Weapon Skill and Hit rolls for the phase; CRYPTEK units can also ignore Wound-roll modifiers.

stratagems.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
stratagems.description: During the opponent’s Command phase, a NECRONS unit on an objective activates Reanimation Protocols; CRYPTEK units reanimate one additional wound.

stratagems.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
stratagems.description: At the start of Shooting, a CRYPTEK unit grants the CRYPTEK keyword for the phase to one nearby friendly NECRONS model that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE.

stratagems.name: UNTAPPED POWER
stratagems.description: A CRYPTEK unit selected to shoot can choose one additional Technosorcerous Augmentations weapon ability for the phase.

enhancements.name: Atomic Disintegrators
enhancements.description: In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment rule, you can also select from the following abilities: [ANTI‑MONSTER 5+], [ANTI‑VEHICLE 5+].

enhancements.name: Gauntlet of Compression
enhancements.description: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Gravitic Bolas
enhancements.description: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding ^^**Titanic^^** units); until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Quantum Abacus
enhancements.description: Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if it is within range of one or more objectives: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

stratagems.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, the unit can shoot and declare a charge even if it Advanced.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army.
stratagems.description: A DESTROYER CULT unit can shoot and charge after Advancing this turn; usable once per turn.

stratagems.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target your unit.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit selected as a target of that enemy unit.
stratagems.description: After an enemy selects a DESTROYER CULT unit as a target in Shooting or Fight, attacks into that unit suffer -1 to Hit for the phase.

stratagems.name: METHODICAL MURDER
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain SUSTAINED HITS 1.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, that has not shot or fought this phase.
stratagems.description: Use in your Shooting or Fight phase on an eligible non-Monster/non-Vehicle NECRONS unit that has not acted; its weapons gain SUSTAINED HITS 1 for the phase.

stratagems.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first DESTROYER CULT unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
stratagems.effect: The targeted friendly unit activates Reanimation Protocols.
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, within 9 inches of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
stratagems.description: After your first DESTROYER CULT kill of the turn, a nearby eligible NECRONS unit activates Reanimation Protocols.

stratagems.name: SPREADING MADNESS
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to its Charge roll when at least one charge target is already within Engagement Range of a friendly unit.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.description: Give an eligible NECRONS unit +2 to qualifying Charge rolls into enemies already engaged by your army.

stratagems.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: That unit declares and resolves a charge against one or more of those enemy units; it gains no Charge bonus from doing so.
stratagems.target: One eligible NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, within 6 inches of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.description: At the end of the opponent's Charge phase, an eligible nearby NECRONS unit can make a reactive charge, without receiving a Charge bonus.

enhancements.name: Cursed Circlet
enhancements.description:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if any models from the bearer’s unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, the bearer’s unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: the bearer’s unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but the bearer’s unit must finish that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding ^^**Aircraft^^**). 
When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. A unit cannot make a Surge move while it is Battle‑shocked.

enhancements.name: Destroyer Ankh
enhancements.description: The bearer has the ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** keyword. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Nekrosor
enhancements.description: Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Murdermind
enhancements.description: The bearer has the **DESTROYER CULT** keyword. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

stratagems.name: Dominance Protocols
stratagems.effect: That unit has +1 Objective Control until the end of the turn.
stratagems.description: Give one Immortals unit +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Nanosaturation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly Immortals or Necron Warriors unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: The unit can shoot using snap shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That Immortals or Necron Warriors unit.
stratagems.description: After being shot, an Immortals or Necron Warriors unit can return fire using snap shooting against the attacker.

stratagems.name: Will of the Conqueror
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker that unit controls; that objective is secured.
stratagems.target: One friendly Immortals or Necron Warriors unit.
stratagems.description: At the end of Movement, an Immortals or Necron Warriors unit can secure an objective it controls.

stratagems.name: COSMIC PRECISION
stratagems.description: A non-MONSTER NECRONS unit arriving by Deep Strike or Hyperphasing can set up more than 6 inches from enemies, but cannot charge that turn.

stratagems.name: DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR
stratagems.description: A NECRONS unit that arrived through a MONOLITH Eternity Gate this turn becomes eligible to charge this phase.

stratagems.name: ENTROPIC DAMPING
stratagems.description: When a nearby TITANIC model is targeted in Shooting, the attacking unit’s weapons gain HAZARDOUS for the phase.

stratagems.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
stratagems.description: After a NECRONS INFANTRY unit loses models to an attack, relocate it to within 6 inches of a friendly MONOLITH and outside Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: QUANTUM DEFLECTION
stratagems.description: A targeted NECRONS VEHICLE unit gains a 4+ invulnerable save for the phase.

stratagems.name: REANIMATION CRYPTS
stratagems.description: In your Command phase, each of your NECRONS units in Reserves activates its Reanimation Protocols.

enhancements.name: Arisen Tyrant
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the bearer's unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Overseer
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Hyperphasing rule.

enhancements.name: Hyperspatial Transfer Node
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. Each time the bearer's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Osteoclave Fulcrum
enhancements.description: NECRONS model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
stratagems.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS unit scores Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ for the phase.

stratagems.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
stratagems.description: A targeted NECRONS VEHICLE reduces the Damage characteristic of incoming attacks by 1 for the phase.

stratagems.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
stratagems.description: Destroyed LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS that have not fought can fight on a 4+ before being removed.

stratagems.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
stratagems.description: A LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit gains PRECISION on its melee weapons for the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
stratagems.description: A LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit gains +1 OC until your next Command phase; VEHICLE units gain +3 OC instead.

stratagems.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
stratagems.description: After the enemy WARLORD is destroyed, your NECRONS WARLORD imposes -1 on enemy Battle-shock and Leadership tests for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Eternal Conqueror
enhancements.description: OVERLORD model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Honourable Combatant
enhancements.description: OVERLORD model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, your opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

enhancements.name: Unflinching Will
enhancements.description: OVERLORD model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] and [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warrior Noble
enhancements.description: OVERLORD model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: CHRONODISTORTION
stratagems.description: When a NECRONS unit is attacked in Fight, destroyed models that have not fought can fight before removal on a 4+, improved when the attacker is unravelling.

stratagems.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
stratagems.description: When a NECRONS MONSTER is destroyed, its Deadly Demise triggers mortal wounds on a 3+ instead of only on a 6 for that resolution.

stratagems.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
stratagems.description: A non-MONSTER NECRONS unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 for the phase and also re-rolls Wound rolls of 1 against unravelling targets.

stratagems.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
stratagems.description: After a NECRONS MONSTER destroys an unravelling enemy, a nearby friendly non-MONSTER NECRONS unit activates Reanimation Protocols.

stratagems.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
stratagems.description: A NECRONS MONSTER forces one visible unravelling enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test at -1; if failed, it suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: PHASE MELDING
stratagems.description: When an unravelling enemy Falls Back from a NECRONS unit, every model in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test, with a penalty if Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Animus Damper
enhancements.description: Once per turn, at the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy ^^**Vehicle^^** unit visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if that Leadership test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

allowedHosts: C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon

enhancements.name: Quantum Goad
enhancements.description: This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Reletavistic Tether
enhancements.description: In your turn, when this unit makes an ingress/advance move using its Transdimensional Displacement ability, this unit can end that move more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"). When this unit ends that move within 8" of an enemy unit, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Evasive Protocols
stratagems.description: When a NECRONS MOUNTED unit is targeted in Shooting, attacks with Strength greater than its Toughness suffer -1 to Wound.

stratagems.name: Omnilocked Strafing
stratagems.description: A NECRONS MOUNTED unit that Falls Back remains eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Swift As Death
stratagems.description: After an enemy ends a move within 8 inches of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit, that unit can make a Normal move of D3+3 inches.

stratagems.name: CHRONOSHIFT
stratagems.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit that Advances adds a flat 6 inches to Move instead of rolling.

stratagems.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
stratagems.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit can move horizontally through models and terrain for the phase.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
stratagems.description: At the end of your Fight phase, a qualifying NECRONS unit on an objective you control activates Reanimation Protocols.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
stratagems.description: A non-MONSTER, non-TITANIC NECRONS unit gains +1 to Wound against targets within range of objective markers for the phase.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
stratagems.description: After a non-MONSTER, non-TITANIC NECRONS unit is shot, it can make a Normal move of up to D6 inches.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
stratagems.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit gains -1 to incoming Wound rolls when attack Strength exceeds its Toughness.

enhancements.name: Chrono-impedance Fields
enhancements.description: In your Command phase, select one friendly **^^Necrons Vehicle^^** or **^^Necrons Mounted^^** unit (excluding Titanic units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Demanding Leader
enhancements.description: In your Command phase, select one friendly NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Miniaturised Nebuloscope
enhancements.description: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: Cosmic Storm
stratagems.description: When an Obelisk or Tesseract Vault shoots, its Tesla Sphere weapons gain +1 AP for that shooting.

stratagems.name: Particle Pulse
stratagems.description: At the start of Shooting, a NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit marks one visible enemy within 12 inches; that enemy’s detection range increases by 3 inches.

stratagems.name: Subsurface Quantumweave
stratagems.description: When a NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit is targeted, incoming attacks have 1 worse AP until that enemy unit finishes attacking.

enhancements.name: Prelocational Optimiser
enhancements.description:
When this unit is selected to shoot, if this unit was set up using a Monolith’s Eternity Gate ability this turn, this unit’s ranged attacks have: 
- [LETHAL HITS]. 
- Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
